statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The clinical indication note raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The note indicates continuous rhythm monitoring to assess arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management
